fullPassage:
Various Volunteer Activities You Might Want to Participate in

Reading Volunteer Work
It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them. This activity offers the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and demonstrating proficiency in standard language use and pronunciation.

Tree Caring Volunteer Work
Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees beautiful and clean. Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once planted. It is a volunteer activity in which local organizations and residents adopt "my tree" and take care of it and keep it clean. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day. During this event, citizens come together to plant and care for trees along the Hangang River.

Longevity Photography Volunteer Work
Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial burdens. In addition to photography services, you can also contribute through talent donations that match your skills, such as providing makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.

questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually (A)[impaired / enhanced] or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them. This activity offers the advantage of relatively (B)[flexible / rigid] scheduling. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and demonstrating (C)[proficiency / deficiency] in standard language use and pronunciation.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 시각 장애인(impaired)에게 낭독. 비교적 유연한(flexible) 일정. 표준어 사용과 발음의 숙달(proficiency).
det.analysis:
✅ ① impaired–flexible–proficiency: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ② rigid(경직된)는 flexible의 반의어
❌ ③ enhanced(향상된)는 impaired의 반의어, deficiency(결핍)는 proficiency의 반의어
❌ ④ 전부 부적합
det.tip: impaired(손상된) ↔ enhanced(향상된) / flexible(유연한) ↔ rigid(경직된) / proficiency(숙달) ↔ deficiency(결핍)

questions.passage: Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees beautiful and clean. Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once planted. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation (A)[dedicated / opposed] to expanding and (B)[preserving / destroying] green spaces, organizes an (C)[annual / occasional] event on Arbor Day. During this event, citizens come together to plant and care for trees along the Hangang River.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 녹지 확장과 보존(preserving)에 전념하는(dedicated) 비영리 재단. 식목일에 연례(annual) 행사.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ dedicated–preserving–annual: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ① expanding은 (B)위치에 부적합 (preserving이 정답)
❌ ② shrinking(축소)은 preserving의 반의어
❌ ④ occasional(가끔)은 annual(연례)과 다름
det.tip: dedicated to ~ing (~에 전념하는) / preserving(보존) ↔ destroying(파괴) / annual(연례) ↔ occasional(가끔)

questions.passage: Longevity photography is a service (A)[aimed / opposed] at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to (B)[ease / worsen] their financial (C)[burdens / donations]. In addition to photography services, you can also contribute through talent donations that match your skills, such as providing makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 건강하고 행복한 추억을 만드는 것을 목표로(aimed). 재정적 부담(burdens)을 덜어주기(ease) 위해.
det.analysis:
✅ ② aimed–ease–burdens: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ① donations(기부)는 burdens 자리에 부적합
❌ ③ increase(증가)는 ease의 반의어, directed는 aimed과 유사하나 donations 부적합
❌ ④ worsen(악화)은 ease의 반의어
det.tip: aimed at ~ing (~을 목표로 하는) / ease(완화하다) ↔ worsen(악화시키다) / burdens(부담) ↔ benefits(혜택)

questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the ①<u>production</u> of audiobooks for them. This activity offers the advantage of relatively ②<u>rigid</u> scheduling. However, participants must meet certain ③<u>standards</u>, including completing their education and demonstrating ④<u>proficiency</u> in standard language use and pronunciation.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② rigid(경직된) → 원문: flexible(유연한). 이 활동은 비교적 '유연한' 일정의 장점이 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ②: rigid(경직된)는 flexible(유연한)의 반의어. 장점으로 소개하면서 경직된 일정은 모순.
❌ ① production(제작) 원문 적합
❌ ③ standards(기준) 원문 적합
❌ ④ proficiency(숙달) 원문 적합
det.tip: flexible(유연한) ↔ rigid(경직된). flexible scheduling = 유연한 일정 관리

questions.passage: Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees ①<u>beautiful</u> and clean. Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once ②<u>planted</u>. It is a volunteer activity in which local organizations and residents adopt "my tree" and take care of it. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to ③<u>reducing</u> and preserving green spaces, ④<u>organizes</u> an annual event on Arbor Day.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ reducing(축소) → 원문: expanding(확장). 녹지를 '확장'하고 보존하는 데 전념하는 재단.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ③: reducing(축소)는 expanding(확장)의 반의어. 녹지를 축소가 아니라 확장.
❌ ① beautiful(아름다운) 원문 적합
❌ ② planted(심어진) 원문 적합
❌ ④ organizes(조직하다) 원문 적합
det.tip: expanding(확장) ↔ reducing(축소). dedicated to expanding and preserving = 확장과 보존에 전념하는

questions.passage: Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy ①<u>memories</u> through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ②<u>ease</u> their financial burdens. In addition to photography services, you can also ③<u>contribute</u> through talent donations that ④<u>contradict</u> your skills, such as providing makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ contradict(모순되다) → 원문: match(일치하다). 재능 기부는 자신의 기술과 '일치하는' 것이어야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ④: contradict(모순)는 match(일치)의 반의어. 기술과 일치해야 함.
❌ ① memories(추억) 원문 적합
❌ ② ease(완화하다) 원문 적합
❌ ③ contribute(기여하다) 원문 적합
det.tip: match(일치하다) ↔ contradict(모순되다). talent donations that match your skills = 기술에 맞는 재능 기부

questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them. This activity offers the advantage of relatively flexible __________. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and demonstrating proficiency in standard language use and pronunciation.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 활동은 비교적 유연한 일정(scheduling)의 이점을 제공한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ scheduling: flexible scheduling. 원문 표현.
❌ ① production(제작)은 audiobooks와 관련
❌ ② pronunciation(발음)은 기준 관련
❌ ③ proficiency(숙달)는 기준 관련
det.tip: scheduling(일정 조정). flexible scheduling = 유연한 일정 관리

questions.passage: Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees beautiful and clean. Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once planted. It is a volunteer activity in which local organizations and residents adopt "my tree" and take care of it and keep it clean. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and __________ green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day. During this event, citizens come together to plant and care for trees along the Hangang River.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 녹지를 확장하고 보존(preserving)하는 데 전념하는 재단.
det.analysis:
✅ ① preserving: expanding and preserving green spaces. 원문 표현.
❌ ② planting(심기)는 나무에 관한 것이지 녹지 보존 아님
❌ ③ adopting(입양)은 나무 입양 문맥과 혼동
❌ ④ organizing(조직)은 행사 관련
det.tip: preserving(보존). expanding and preserving = 확장하고 보존하는

questions.passage: Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees beautiful and clean. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day. Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial __________. In addition to photography services, you can also contribute through talent donations that match your skills, such as providing makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 노인들의 재정적 부담(burdens)을 덜어주기 위해서이기도 하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ burdens: ease their financial burdens. 원문 표현.
❌ ① memories(추억)는 서비스 목적과 관련
❌ ② services(서비스)는 photography services와 혼동
❌ ④ donations(기부)는 talent donations과 혼동
det.tip: financial burdens(재정적 부담). ease burdens = 부담을 완화하다

questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them. However, participants must meet certain standards, <u>including</u> completing their education and demonstrating proficiency.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 including과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 교육 이수와 숙달 입증을 포함하여(including).
det.analysis:
✅ ② include: including = ~을 포함하여. 동의어.
❌ ① take part in(참여하다)는 participate의 동의어
❌ ③ consist of(~으로 구성되다)는 전체 구성
❌ ④ demand(요구하다)는 meet standards와 관련
det.tip: including(~을 포함하여) = such as, for example

questions.passage: The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation <u>dedicated</u> to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day. During this event, citizens come together to plant and care for trees along the Hangang River.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 dedicated와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 녹지 확장과 보존에 전념하는(dedicated) 비영리 재단.
det.analysis:
✅ ① committed: dedicated = committed (전념하는). 동의어.
❌ ② opposed(반대하는)는 반의어
❌ ③ related(관련된)는 약한 연결
❌ ④ accustomed(익숙한)는 다른 의미
det.tip: dedicated to(~에 전념하는) = committed to, devoted to

questions.passage: Longevity photography is a service <u>aimed</u> at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial burdens.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 aimed와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 건강하고 행복한 추억을 만드는 것을 목표로 하는(aimed) 서비스.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ targeted: aimed at = targeted at (~을 목표로 하는). 동의어.
❌ ① intended(의도된)는 유사하지만 aimed at의 직접 동의어는 targeted
❌ ② directed(지시된)는 다른 뉘앙스
❌ ③ designed(설계된)는 목적보다 설계 의미
det.tip: aimed at(~을 목표로 하는) = targeted at. be aimed at ~ing = ~하는 것을 목표로 하다

questions.passage: Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that <u>helps</u> keep trees beautiful and clean. Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once planted.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 helps와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 나무를 아름답고 깨끗하게 유지하는 것을 돕는(helps) 봉사활동.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ hindered: helps(돕다) ↔ hindered(방해하다). 반의어.
❌ ① damaged(손상시키다)는 물리적 손상
❌ ② weakened(약화시키다)는 힘 관련
❌ ④ blocked(차단하다)는 물리적 차단
det.tip: help(돕다) ↔ hinder(방해하다). help keep = 유지하는 것을 돕다

questions.passage: This activity offers the advantage of relatively <u>flexible</u> scheduling. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and demonstrating proficiency in standard language use and pronunciation.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 flexible과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 비교적 유연한(flexible) 일정의 이점.
det.analysis:
✅ ② rigid: flexible(유연한) ↔ rigid(경직된). 정확한 반의어.
❌ ① temporary(일시적)는 시간 관련
❌ ③ optional(선택적)은 flexible과 유사
❌ ④ voluntary(자발적)는 의지 관련
det.tip: flexible(유연한) ↔ rigid(경직된). flexible scheduling = 유연한 일정

questions.passage:
(A) Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once <u>planted</u>.
(B) During this event, citizens come together to <u>plant</u> and care for trees along the Hangang River.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A) planted와 (B) plant의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 나무를 심은(planted) 후 돌봄. (B) 나무를 심고(plant) 돌보기 위해.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 심다–돌보다: (A) planted = 심어진, (B) plant = 심다. 둘 다 '심다'의 의미이나 문맥상 (A)는 심은 후 돌봄, (B)는 심고 돌봄.
❌ ① 식물–계획: plant가 명사(식물)나 동사(계획하다)일 수 있으나 여기선 아님
❌ ② 공장–시설: plant의 다른 의미이나 문맥 부적합
❌ ③ 심다–설비: (B)의 설비는 부적합
det.tip: plant: ① 식물(명사) ② 공장(명사) ③ 심다(동사) ④ 설치하다(동사). 여기서는 둘 다 '심다'

questions.stem: "a high degree of skill; expertise" — 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어는?

det.korean: 높은 수준의 기술; 전문성 → proficiency(숙달)
det.analysis:
✅ ① proficiency: 높은 기술 수준, 숙달.
❌ ② donation(기부)은 베풀기
❌ ③ scheduling(일정 조정)은 시간 관리
❌ ④ foundation(재단)은 조직
det.tip: proficiency(숙달, 능숙함). demonstrate proficiency = 숙달을 보여주다

questions.passage: However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and __________ (demonstrate) proficiency in standard language use.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 교육 이수와 표준어 사용 숙달을 입증하는 것(demonstrating)을 포함하여.
det.analysis: including 뒤에 동명사(~ing)가 와야 병렬 구조: completing ... and demonstrating ...
det.tip: 병렬 구조: including A and B → 둘 다 ~ing 형태. completing and demonstrating

questions.passage: The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation __________ (dedicate) to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 녹지 확장과 보존에 전념하는(dedicated) 비영리 재단.
det.analysis: 과거분사 dedicated가 명사 foundation을 수식. dedicated to ~ing = ~에 전념하는.
det.tip: dedicated to ~ing (~에 전념하는). 과거분사의 형용사적 용법. a foundation dedicated to = ~에 전념하는 재단

questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in __________ for them. This activity offers the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and demonstrating proficiency in standard language use and pronunciation.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그들을 위한 오디오북 제작(the production of audiobooks)에 참여할 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② the production of audiobooks: 시각장애인/어린이를 위한 오디오북 제작.
❌ ① reading aloud는 이미 앞 문장에 언급
❌ ③ flexible scheduling은 활동의 이점이지 참여 내용 아님
❌ ④ demonstrating proficiency는 참가 기준이지 참여 내용 아님
det.tip: participate in the production of = ~의 제작에 참여하다

ch: talent donations that match your skills
questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. This activity offers the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling. Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial burdens. In addition to photography services, you can also contribute through __________, such as providing makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사진 촬영을 위한 메이크업이나 헤어스타일링과 같은 기술에 맞는 재능 기부(talent donations that match your skills).
det.analysis:
✅ ① talent donations that match your skills: such as 이하의 예시(메이크업, 헤어스타일링)와 연결.
❌ ② financial support는 재정 지원이지 재능 기부 아님
❌ ③ longevity photography는 이미 언급된 서비스 자체
❌ ④ volunteer activities for tree planting은 다른 봉사활동
det.tip: talent donations(재능 기부). contribute through talent donations = 재능 기부로 기여하다
